blurb: Temple Bar Marina offers lake-view lodging, RV parking with full hook-ups, a convenience store, gift shop, café, bar, and launch ramp. Guests can rent boats for fishing, kayaking, water skiing, sightseeing, or beach activities. The restaurant and bar are open Thursday through Sunday for breakfast and dinner.
